title: PHP2Shell: two unauthenticated PHP core RCEs broadly exploited; still not in CISA KEV
why: Amazon Threat Intelligence calls it broadly exploited in the wild (first attempt Oct 17, before disclosure), and Cloudflare reports attack traffic. No CISA KEV entry has been found as of Oct 22 (last KEV alert seen was Oct 20).
action: Patch PHP to the fixed builds, including bundled runtimes and container images. Where you can't, apply PHP's memory_limit/session.upload_progress mitigations and put WAF rules in front. Hunt from Oct 17 onward.

title: PAN-OS GlobalProtect auth bypass: new k0t edge-device campaign exploiting it alongside FortiWeb CVE-2025-64446 (KEV)
why: Already in CISA KEV; Microsoft is onto it.
action: Confirm PAN-OS and FortiWeb are patched and hunt for AdaptixC2 and credential harvesting on edge devices.

title: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL injection zero-day exploited in the wild: any logged-in user becomes superuser operator
why: Arista advisory 0199 (Oct 22) says Arista found the flaw and it is being actively exploited; covered by THN, BleepingComputer and SecurityOnline. It is not in CISA KEV: the latest KEV additions found were from Oct 20, and the collector saw no new KEV entries this run. Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade on-prem VCO to 5.2.3.18, 6.1.3.10 or 6.4.2.12. Until then, restrict the web UI to admin networks, review tenant accounts, and save web logs before patching.

title: Node2Shell: Node.js/Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write, RCE demonstrated on official image, no in-the-wild use yet
why: Imperva demonstrated RCE against the official Node.js 24.22.0 image, and a public PoC repo exists. Aikido and others report no in-the-wild use as of Oct 22. Not in CISA KEV.
action: Rebuild every Node-based image on a fixed runtime, and reject Content-Encoding: br at the edge until that's done.

title: Splunk Enterprise unauthenticated RCE via Patroni REST API on search head cluster members: public PoC and scanner template
why: A public GitHub PoC (check and mass-exploit modes) and a ProjectDiscovery detection template now exist, and Horizon3 published a rapid-response test on Oct 22. Splunk makes no exploitation statement and the CVE is not in CISA KEV. Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade SHC members to 10.4.3 or 10.2.7. If Edge Processor, OpAmp and SPL2 pipelines aren't used, set [postgres] disabled=true and block the Patroni port (often 8008) from untrusted networks.

title: FortiSIEM unauthenticated gRPC path traversal to RCE: public PoC, still not in CISA KEV
why: Horizon3 published a working unauthenticated RCE PoC on Oct 20. Fortinet says not known exploited and the CVE is not in CISA KEV as of Oct 22.
action: Upgrade FortiSIEM to 7.5.1+/7.6, block tcp/27918 from untrusted networks, and check timestamps of /opt/charting/redishb.sh and phLicenseTool.

title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply-chain compromise: credential-stealing release on PyPI and Docker; LiteLLM now suspects GitHub token leaked via AI gateway logs
why: Malicious 1.107.0 release with a credential stealer/backdoor was published Oct 21 and stolen cloud credentials were abused (Wiz). Socket and Datadog have published analyses; no MSRC/KEV signal (supply-chain, no CVE).
action: Find any host/container that installed litellm 1.107.0, pin 1.106.2, and rotate every credential reachable from those environments.

title: ConnectWise Cloud Backup (SkyKick) supply-chain compromise used to reach Microsoft 365 tenants (Storm-0940, ARTEX AI agents)
action: If ConnectWise Cloud Backup/SkyKick was ever consented in your tenant, export Entra sign-in/audit logs now, review service principal sign-ins and hunt for app credential or role changes you did not make.

title: YOOtheme Pro 5 unauthenticated RCE via image handler (CVSS 10), CNA marks it as attacked
why: The CNA (Joomla) CVSS 4.0 vector sets E:A (attacked), and VulDB marks it as attacked. No attack details have been published (whatgotpwned), so exploitation is unconfirmed. Not in CISA KEV.
action: Update to 5.0.53 or later, then check public media and cache folders for unexpected .php or polyglot image files.

title: 22 newly assigned CVEs for legacy web apps carry Shadowserver-observed exploitation evidence (DedeCMS, FineReport, Weaver E-cology and others)
why: NVD descriptions for 22 CVEs published Oct 22 state that exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation (mostly Oct 2023; Weaver E-cology CVE-2025-71434 in July 2026). None is in CISA KEV.
action: Search your asset inventory for these products, especially Weaver E-cology (fix 10.76) and FineReport/DedeCMS, and patch or retire internet-facing instances.

title: GitLab CE/EE unauthenticated RCE via Onigmo regex integer overflow (CVSS 10), all versions since 7.0
why: Vendor-disclosed CVSS 10 unauthenticated RCE with wide coverage (BleepingComputer, THN). An earlier GitLab CVE (85706) entered KEV one day after release. As of Oct 22 there is no exploitation, no confirmed PoC and no KEV entry.
action: Upgrade self-managed GitLab, including Geo/DR replicas, to the Oct 21 builds even if you patched on Oct 12.

title: Unpatched Linux KSMBD RCEs (ZDI-CAN-33774 pre-auth, ZDI-CAN-33549 SMB Direct, CVSS 9.0) public on LKML with no mainline fix
why: ZDI's reports were posted to public kernel lists on Oct 21-22 (Phoronix, Slashdot, The Hacker News). As of Oct 23 neither flaw has a mainline fix or CVE, and no exploitation has been reported. Not in KEV.
action: Check for KSMBD (lsmod | grep ksmbd; systemctl status ksmbd). Unload and blacklist it if not needed, and block port 445 from untrusted networks.

title: Laravel TokenGuard unauthenticated authentication bypass / account takeover on MySQL/MariaDB
why: Vendor advisory published in NVD Oct 21 (CVSS 9.2). Not in CISA KEV; no PoC or exploitation seen. Flagged on vendor disclosure alone.
action: Upgrade laravel/framework to 12.68.0 or 13.29.0 on apps that use the token API guard with MySQL/MariaDB.
